'''Jeanne''' is a Giant of the [[Grand Magasin Sisyphe]] and the former lover of [[Meursault]]. She debuts in [[Canto X]]: The Gaze Bearing.

== Canto X ==
Jeanne guides the Sinners through the Sisyphe over its intercom and explains the Liquidation that resets the store. On the rooftop she is revealed as the current Architect. She and Meursault share a fear of being pinned down by the gaze of others; she Distorts, and after a final dance Meursault pries the Golden Bough from her body. She is later found in a coma outside the Sisyphe.
